name: Narros de Saldueña (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided by an embattled line yellow over red.
history: The flag, approved simultaneously with the arms (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 144 of 29 July 2013), is a rectangular cloth one and a half times longer than high; when it bears the municipal arms they are placed in the upper hoist corner at a third of the height.
